crossRefs.note: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart…
Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image…
The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”
“Therefore, you son of man, prepare your stuff for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your…
Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall…
I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with…
“Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

translations.web: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.
translations.bsb: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth
translations.asv: And thou shalt consider in thy heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so Jehovah thy God chasteneth thee.
